    weights = pd.Series(0.0, index=universe, dtype=float)
    if len(universe) == 0:
        return weights

    close_df = history.get('adjusted_close')
    vol_df = history.get('volume')
    if close_df is None or vol_df is None:
        return weights

    idx = close_df.index
    if len(idx) < 6:
        return weights

    vol = vol_df.reindex(index=idx, columns=universe)

    liq_window = 20
    max_side = 40
    max_abs = 0.02

    if base_pos < lookback:

    prev_close = close.iloc[base_pos - lookback]

def _price_frame(history):

        df = history.get(name)
        if isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame) and df.shape[0] > 0 and df.shape[1] > 0:
            return df
    return None

    universe = pd.Index(list(universe))
    weights = pd.Series(0.0, index=universe, dtype=float)
    if len(universe) == 0:
        return weights

    raw_prices = _price_frame(history)
    if raw_prices is None:
        return weights

    prices = raw_prices.reindex(columns=universe).astype(float)
    if prices.shape[0] < 2:
        return weights

    prices = prices.ffill()
    last = prices.iloc[-1]

    elig_df = history.get('eligible')
    if isinstance(elig_df, pd.DataFrame):
        elig = elig_df.reindex(columns=universe).ffill().iloc[-1]
        elig = elig.fillna(False).astype(bool)
    else:
        elig = pd.Series(True, index=universe)

    base_valid = last.notna() & np.isfinite(last) & (last > 0.0) & elig
    if not base_valid.any():
        return weights

    max_lookback = 252
    smooth_days = 5
    need = max_lookback + 80
    px = prices.tail(need)

    if px.shape[0] < 25:
        L = min(20, max(1, px.shape[0] - 1))
        if L < 1:
            return weights
        signal = px.iloc[-1] / px.iloc[-1 - L] - 1.0
        signal = signal.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    else:
        ret = px.pct_change()
        ret = ret.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        vol = ret.rolling(63, min_periods=20).std(ddof=0)
        vol = vol.where(vol > 1e-8)

        lookbacks = [21, 63, 126, 252]
        lb_weights = [0.15, 0.30, 0.30, 0.25]
        comps = []
        for L, wt in zip(lookbacks, lb_weights):
            if px.shape[0] <= L:
                continue
            mom = px / px.shift(L) - 1.0
            mom = mom.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
            comp = mom / (vol * math.sqrt(float(L)))
            comp = comp.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
            mu = comp.mean(axis=1, skipna=True)
            sd = comp.std(axis=1, ddof=0, skipna=True)
            sd = sd.where(sd > 1e-12)
            z = comp.sub(mu, axis=0).div(sd, axis=0)

            z_s = z.tail(smooth_days).mean(axis=0, skipna=True)
            comps.append(z_s * wt)

        if comps:
            signal = pd.concat(comps, axis=1).sum(axis=1, min_count=1)
        else:
            L = min(20, max(1, px.shape[0] - 1))
            signal = px.iloc[-1] / px.iloc[-1 - L] - 1.0
            signal = signal.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

    valid = base_valid & signal.notna() & np.isfinite(signal)
    candidates = signal[valid]
    n = int(candidates.shape[0])

        return weights

    weights.loc[shorts] = -per_name

        df = history.get(name)
        if isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame) and df.shape[0] > 0 and df.shape[1] > 0:
            return df
    return None

    universe = pd.Index(list(universe))
    weights = pd.Series(0.0, index=universe, dtype=float)
    if len(universe) == 0:
        return weights

    raw_prices = _price_frame(history)
    if raw_prices is None:
        return weights

    prices = raw_prices.reindex(columns=universe).astype(float)
    if prices.shape[0] < 2:
        return weights

    prices = prices.ffill()
    last = prices.iloc[-1]

    elig_df = history.get('eligible')
    if isinstance(elig_df, pd.DataFrame):
        elig = elig_df.reindex(columns=universe).ffill().iloc[-1]
        elig = elig.fillna(False).astype(bool)
    else:
        elig = pd.Series(True, index=universe)

    base_valid = last.notna() & np.isfinite(last) & (last > 0.0) & elig
    if not base_valid.any():
        return weights

    max_lookback = 252
    smooth_days = 5
    need = max_lookback + 80
    px = prices.tail(need)

    if px.shape[0] < 25:
        L = min(20, max(1, px.shape[0] - 1))
        if L < 1:
            return weights
        signal = px.iloc[-1] / px.iloc[-1 - L] - 1.0
        signal = signal.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    else:
        ret = px.pct_change()
        ret = ret.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        vol = ret.rolling(63, min_periods=20).std(ddof=0)
        vol = vol.where(vol > 1e-8)

        lookbacks = [21, 63, 126, 252]
        lb_weights = [0.15, 0.30, 0.30, 0.25]
        comps = []
        for L, wt in zip(lookbacks, lb_weights):
            if px.shape[0] <= L:
                continue
            mom = px / px.shift(L) - 1.0
            mom = mom.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
            comp = mom / (vol * math.sqrt(float(L)))
            comp = comp.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
            mu = comp.mean(axis=1, skipna=True)
            sd = comp.std(axis=1, ddof=0, skipna=True)
            sd = sd.where(sd > 1e-12)
            z = comp.sub(mu, axis=0).div(sd, axis=0)
            z = z.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
            z_s = z.tail(smooth_days).mean(axis=0, skipna=True)
            comps.append(z_s * wt)

        if comps:

import pandas as pd

def _zeros(universe):
    return pd.Series(0.0, index=pd.Index(universe), dtype=float)

def generate_weights(history, universe):
    out = _zeros(universe)
    tickers = pd.Index(universe)
    if len(tickers) == 0:
        return out
    try:
        px_all = history.get('adjusted_close')
        if px_all is None:
            px_all = history.get('close')
    except Exception:
        return out
    if not isinstance(px_all, pd.DataFrame) or len(px_all) < 10:
        return out
    common = [t for t in tickers if t in px_all.columns]
    if len(common) < 10:
        return out
    mom_window = 120
    vol_window = 60
    beta_window = 120
    need = mom_window + 5
    px = px_all.loc[:, common]
    if len(px) > need:
        px = px.iloc[-need:]
    px = px.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='coerce')
    if len(px) <= mom_window:
        return out
    last_px = px.iloc[-1]
    eligible = pd.Series(True, index=common)
    try:
        e_all = history.get('eligible')
        if isinstance(e_all, pd.DataFrame):
            e = e_all.reindex(index=px.index, columns=common)
            eligible = e.iloc[-1].fillna(True).astype(bool)
    except Exception:
        pass
    rets = px.pct_change(fill_method=None)
    rets = rets.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    vol60 = rets.tail(vol_window).std(ddof=0, skipna=True)
    cnt = rets.tail(mom_window).count()
    ret120 = px.iloc[-1] / px.iloc[-mom_window - 1] - 1.0
    R = rets.tail(beta_window)
    m = R.mean(axis=1)
    Rd = R.sub(R.mean(axis=0), axis=1)
    md = m - m.mean()
    denom = (md ** 2).sum()
    if denom <= 0 or not np.isfinite(denom):
        beta = pd.Series(1.0, index=common)
        mret = 0.0
    else:
        var = denom / max(len(Rd) - 1, 1)
        cov = Rd.mul(md, axis=0).sum() / max(len(Rd) - 1, 1)
        beta = cov / var
        vals = m.dropna().values
        mret = float(np.prod(1.0 + vals) - 1.0) if len(vals) else 0.0
    if not np.isfinite(mret):
        mret = 0.0
    resid_ret = ret120 - beta * mret
    risk_adj = resid_ret / (vol60 * np.sqrt(mom_window))
    mask = (eligible & np.isfinite(last_px) & (last_px > 0) & np.isfinite(vol60) & (vol60 > 0) & np.isfinite(ret120) & np.isfinite(beta) & np.isfinite(resid_ret) & np.isfinite(risk_adj) & (cnt >= 90))
    valid = pd.DataFrame({'vol': vol60, 'ra': risk_adj}, index=common)
    valid = valid[mask.reindex(valid.index).fillna(False)]
    if len(valid) < 10:
        return out
    vol_rank = valid['vol'].rank(method='average', pct=True)
    ra_rank = valid['ra'].rank(method='average', pct=True)
    score = 0.7 * (1.0 - vol_rank) + 0.3 * ra_rank
    score = score.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()
    if len(score) < 10:
        return out
    n_side = min(20, len(score) // 2)
    if n_side < 5:
        return out
    ordered = score.sort_values(ascending=False)
    longs = ordered.iloc[:n_side].index
    shorts = ordered.iloc[-n_side:].index
    w = min(0.02, 0.4 / float(n_side))

    out.loc[shorts] = -w

    return out

import pandas as pd


def _get_field(history, name, fallback, universe):
    df = history.get(name)
    if df is None and fallback is not None:
        df = history.get(fallback)
    if df is None or not isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame):
        return None
    return df.reindex(columns=universe).astype(float)


def generate_weights(history, universe):
    universe = pd.Index(universe)
    zero = pd.Series(0.0, index=universe, dtype=float)
    if len(universe) == 0:
        return zero

    close = _get_field(history, 'adjusted_close', 'close', universe)
    openp = _get_field(history, 'adjusted_open', 'open', universe)
    volume = _get_field(history, 'volume', None, universe)
    if close is None or openp is None or volume is None:
        return zero

    n = min(len(close), 60)
    if n < 10:
        return zero
    close = close.iloc[-n:]
    openp = openp.iloc[-n:]
    volume = volume.iloc[-n:]

    prev_close = close.shift(1)
    overnight = openp / prev_close - 1.0
    intraday = close / openp - 1.0

    if len(close) < 6:
        return zero

    o5 = (1.0 + overnight.iloc[-5:]).prod(min_count=5) - 1.0
    i5 = (1.0 + intraday.iloc[-5:]).prod(min_count=5) - 1.0

    recent_vol = volume.iloc[-5:].mean()
    if len(volume) >= 25:
        base = volume.iloc[-25:-5].median()
    elif len(volume) >= 10:
        base = volume.iloc[:-5].median()
    else:
        base = volume.median()
    base = base.where(base > 0, np.nan)
    ratio = (recent_vol / base).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    ratio = ratio.clip(lower=1e-2, upper=1e2)
    log_shock = np.log(ratio)

    elig_df = history.get('eligible')
    if isinstance(elig_df, pd.DataFrame):
        elig = elig_df.reindex(columns=universe).iloc[-1]
        elig = elig.fillna(False).astype(bool)
    else:
        elig = pd.Series(True, index=universe, dtype=bool)

    last_close = close.iloc[-1]
    last_open = openp.iloc[-1]
    last_vol = volume.iloc[-1]

    o5 = o5.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    i5 = i5.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

    valid = (
        elig &
        last_close.notna() & last_open.notna() & last_vol.notna() &
        (last_close > 0) & (last_open > 0) & (last_vol > 0) &
        o5.notna() & i5.notna() & log_shock.notna()
    )

    if valid.sum() < 2:
        return zero

    ri = i5.rank(pct=True) - 0.5
    rs = log_shock.rank(pct=True)
    score = ro - ri * (1.0 + rs)
    score = score.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    valid = valid & score.notna()

    cand = score[valid].sort_values(ascending=False)
    m = len(cand)
    if m < 2:
        return zero

    N = min(50, m // 2)
    if N < 1:
        return zero

    longs = cand.index[:N]
    shorts = cand.index[-N:]
    weight = min(0.5 / N, 0.02)

    w = zero.copy()
    w.loc[longs] = weight
    w.loc[shorts] = -weight
    w = w.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0)
    w = w.clip(lower=-0.02, upper=0.02)

    gross = w.abs().sum()
    if gross > 1.0:
        w = w / gross

    return w.astype(float)

        return weights

    close_df = history.get('adjusted_close')
    vol_df = history.get('volume')
    if close_df is None or vol_df is None:
        return weights

    idx = close_df.index
    if len(idx) < 6:
        return weights

    close = close_df.reindex(index=idx, columns=universe)
    vol = vol_df.reindex(index=idx, columns=universe)

    lookback = 3
    liq_window = 20
    max_side = 40
    max_abs = 0.02

    last_pos = len(idx) - 1
    base_pos = last_pos - (last_pos % 5)

    if base_pos < min_pos:
        base_pos = last_pos
    if base_pos < lookback:
        return weights

    base_close = close.iloc[base_pos]
    prev_close = close.iloc[base_pos - lookback]
    sig = base_close / prev_close - 1.0
    sig = sig.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

    start = max(0, base_pos - liq_window + 1)
    close_slice = close.iloc[start:base_pos + 1]
    vol_slice = vol.iloc[start:base_pos + 1]
    dollar_vol = close_slice * vol_slice

import pandas as pd


def _price_frame(history):
    for name in ('adjusted_close', 'close'):
        df = history.get(name)
        if isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame) and df.shape[0] > 0 and df.shape[1] > 0:
            return df
    return None


def generate_weights(history, universe):
    universe = pd.Index(list(universe))
    weights = pd.Series(0.0, index=universe, dtype=float)
    if len(universe) == 0:
        return weights

    raw_prices = _price_frame(history)
    if raw_prices is None:
        return weights

    prices = raw_prices.reindex(columns=universe).astype(float)
    if prices.shape[0] < 2:
        return weights

    prices = prices.ffill()
    last = prices.iloc[-1]

    elig_df = history.get('eligible')
    if isinstance(elig_df, pd.DataFrame):
        elig = elig_df.reindex(columns=universe).ffill().iloc[-1]
        elig = elig.fillna(False).astype(bool)
    else:
        elig = pd.Series(True, index=universe)

    base_valid = last.notna() & np.isfinite(last) & (last > 0.0) & elig
    if not base_valid.any():
        return weights

    max_lookback = 252
    smooth_days = 5
    need = max_lookback + 80
    px = prices.tail(need)

    if px.shape[0] < 25:
        L = min(20, max(1, px.shape[0] - 1))
        if L < 1:
            return weights
        signal = px.iloc[-1] / px.iloc[-1 - L] - 1.0
        signal = signal.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    else:
        ret = px.pct_change()
        ret = ret.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        vol = ret.rolling(63, min_periods=20).std(ddof=0)
        vol = vol.where(vol > 1e-8)

        lookbacks = [21, 63, 126, 252]
        lb_weights = [0.15, 0.30, 0.30, 0.25]
        comps = []
        for L, wt in zip(lookbacks, lb_weights):
            if px.shape[0] <= L:
                continue
            mom = px / px.shift(L) - 1.0
            mom = mom.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
            comp = mom / (vol * math.sqrt(float(L)))
            comp = comp.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
            mu = comp.mean(axis=1, skipna=True)
            sd = comp.std(axis=1, ddof=0, skipna=True)
            sd = sd.where(sd > 1e-12)
            z = comp.sub(mu, axis=0).div(sd, axis=0)
            z = z.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
            z_s = z.tail(smooth_days).mean(axis=0, skipna=True)
            comps.append(z_s * wt)

        if comps:
            signal = pd.concat(comps, axis=1).sum(axis=1, min_count=1)
        else:
            L = min(20, max(1, px.shape[0] - 1))
            signal = px.iloc[-1] / px.iloc[-1 - L] - 1.0
            signal = signal.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

    signal = signal.reindex(universe)
    valid = base_valid & signal.notna() & np.isfinite(signal)
    candidates = signal[valid]
    n = int(candidates.shape[0])
    if n < 2:
        return weights

    N = min(50, n // 2)
    if N < 1:
        return weights

    ordered = candidates.sort_values(ascending=False, kind='mergesort')
    longs = ordered.index[:N]
    shorts = ordered.index[-N:]

    per_name = min(0.02, 1.0 / (2.0 * float(N)))
    weights.loc[longs] = per_name
    weights.loc[shorts] = -per_name

    weights = weights.clip(-0.02, 0.02)
    gross = float(weights.abs().sum())
    if gross > 1.0 + 1e-12:
        weights = weights * (1.0 / gross)

    return weights.fillna(0.0).astype(float)

        return out
    common = [t for t in tickers if t in px_all.columns]
    if len(common) < 10:
        return out
    mom_window = 120
    vol_window = 60
    beta_window = 120
    need = mom_window + 5
    px = px_all.loc[:, common]
    if len(px) > need:
        px = px.iloc[-need:]
    px = px.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='coerce')
    if len(px) <= mom_window:
        return out
    last_px = px.iloc[-1]
    eligible = pd.Series(True, index=common)
    try:
        e_all = history.get('eligible')
        if isinstance(e_all, pd.DataFrame):
            e = e_all.reindex(index=px.index, columns=common)
            eligible = e.iloc[-1].fillna(True).astype(bool)
    except Exception:
        pass
    rets = px.pct_change(fill_method=None)
    rets = rets.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    vol60 = rets.tail(vol_window).std(ddof=0, skipna=True)

    ret120 = px.iloc[-1] / px.iloc[-mom_window - 1] - 1.0

    Rd = R.sub(R.mean(axis=0), axis=1)
    md = m - m.mean()
    denom = (md ** 2).sum()
    if denom <= 0 or not np.isfinite(denom):
        beta = pd.Series(1.0, index=common)
        mret = 0.0
    else:
        var = denom / max(len(Rd) - 1, 1)
        cov = Rd.mul(md, axis=0).sum() / max(len(Rd) - 1, 1)
        beta = cov / var
        vals = m.dropna().values

def generate_weights(history, universe):

    if len(tickers) == 0:
        return out
    try:
        px_all = history.get('adjusted_close')
        if px_all is None:

    if not isinstance(px_all, pd.DataFrame) or len(px_all) < 10:
        return out
    common = [t for t in tickers if t in px_all.columns]
    if len(common) < 10:
        return out
    mom_window = 120
    vol_window = 60
    beta_window = 120
    need = mom_window + 5
    px = px_all.loc[:, common]
    if len(px) > need:
        px = px.iloc[-need:]
    px = px.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='coerce')
    if len(px) <= mom_window:
        return out
    last_px = px.iloc[-1]
    eligible = pd.Series(True, index=common)
    try:
        e_all = history.get('eligible')
        if isinstance(e_all, pd.DataFrame):
            e = e_all.reindex(index=px.index, columns=common)
            eligible = e.iloc[-1].fillna(True).astype(bool)
    except Exception:
        pass
    rets = px.pct_change(fill_method=None)
    rets = rets.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    vol60 = rets.tail(vol_window).std(ddof=0, skipna=True)
    cnt = rets.tail(mom_window).count()
    ret120 = px.iloc[-1] / px.iloc[-mom_window - 1] - 1.0
    R = rets.tail(beta_window)
    m = R.mean(axis=1)
    Rd = R.sub(R.mean(axis=0), axis=1)
    md = m - m.mean()
    denom = (md ** 2).sum()
    if denom <= 0 or not np.isfinite(denom):
        beta = pd.Series(1.0, index=common)
        mret = 0.0
    else:
        var = denom / max(len(Rd) - 1, 1)
        cov = Rd.mul(md, axis=0).sum() / max(len(Rd) - 1, 1)
        beta = cov / var
        vals = m.dropna().values
        mret = float(np.prod(1.0 + vals) - 1.0) if len(vals) else 0.0
    if not np.isfinite(mret):
        mret = 0.0
    resid_ret = ret120 - beta * mret
    risk_adj = resid_ret / (vol60 * np.sqrt(mom_window))
    mask = (eligible & np.isfinite(last_px) & (last_px > 0) & np.isfinite(vol60) & (vol60 > 0) & np.isfinite(ret120) & np.isfinite(beta) & np.isfinite(resid_ret) & np.isfinite(risk_adj) & (cnt >= 90))
    valid = pd.DataFrame({'vol': vol60, 'ra': risk_adj}, index=common)

    ra_rank = valid['ra'].rank(method='average', pct=True)
    score = 0.7 * (1.0 - vol_rank) + 0.3 * ra_rank
    score = score.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()
    if len(score) < 10:
        return out
    n_side = min(20, len(score) // 2)
    if n_side < 5:
        return out
    ordered = score.sort_values(ascending=False)
    longs = ordered.iloc[:n_side].index
    shorts = ordered.iloc[-n_side:].index
    w = min(0.02, 0.4 / float(n_side))
    out.loc[longs] = w
    out.loc[shorts] = -w
    out = out.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0).clip(-0.02, 0.02)
    gross = out.abs().sum()
    if gross > 1.0:
        out = out * (1.0 / gross)
    if abs(out.sum()) > 0.01:
        return _zeros(universe)
    return out

    openp = _get_field(history, 'adjusted_open', 'open', universe)
    volume = _get_field(history, 'volume', None, universe)
    if close is None or openp is None or volume is None:
        return zero

    n = min(len(close), 60)
    if n < 10:
        return zero
    close = close.iloc[-n:]
    openp = openp.iloc[-n:]
    volume = volume.iloc[-n:]

    prev_close = close.shift(1)
    overnight = openp / prev_close - 1.0
    intraday = close / openp - 1.0

    if len(close) < 6:
        return zero

    o5 = (1.0 + overnight.iloc[-5:]).prod(min_count=5) - 1.0
    i5 = (1.0 + intraday.iloc[-5:]).prod(min_count=5) - 1.0

    recent_vol = volume.iloc[-5:].mean()
    if len(volume) >= 25:
        base = volume.iloc[-25:-5].median()
    elif len(volume) >= 10:
        base = volume.iloc[:-5].median()
    else:
        base = volume.median()
    base = base.where(base > 0, np.nan)
    ratio = (recent_vol / base).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    ratio = ratio.clip(lower=1e-2, upper=1e2)
    log_shock = np.log(ratio)

    elig_df = history.get('eligible')

        elig = elig_df.reindex(columns=universe).iloc[-1]

    elif len(volume) >= 10:
        base = volume.iloc[:-5].median()
    else:
        base = volume.median()

    ratio = (recent_vol / base).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

def _zeros(universe):
    return pd.Series(0.0, index=pd.Index(universe), dtype=float)

def generate_weights(history, universe):
    out = _zeros(universe)
    tickers = pd.Index(universe)
    if len(tickers) == 0:
        return out
    try:
        px_all = history.get('adjusted_close')
        if px_all is None:
            px_all = history.get('close')
    except Exception:
        return out
    if not isinstance(px_all, pd.DataFrame) or len(px_all) < 10:
        return out
    common = [t for t in tickers if t in px_all.columns]
    if len(common) < 10:
        return out
    mom_window = 120
    vol_window = 60
    beta_window = 120
    need = mom_window + 5
    px = px_all.loc[:, common]
    if len(px) > need:
        px = px.iloc[-need:]
    px = px.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='coerce')
    if len(px) <= mom_window:
        return out
    last_px = px.iloc[-1]
    eligible = pd.Series(True, index=common)
    try:
        e_all = history.get('eligible')
        if isinstance(e_all, pd.DataFrame):
            e = e_all.reindex(index=px.index, columns=common)
            eligible = e.iloc[-1].fillna(True).astype(bool)
    except Exception:
        pass
    rets = px.pct_change(fill_method=None)
    rets = rets.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    vol60 = rets.tail(vol_window).std(ddof=0, skipna=True)
    cnt = rets.tail(mom_window).count()
    ret120 = px.iloc[-1] / px.iloc[-mom_window - 1] - 1.0
    R = rets.tail(beta_window)
    m = R.mean(axis=1)
    Rd = R.sub(R.mean(axis=0), axis=1)
    md = m - m.mean()
    denom = (md ** 2).sum()
    if denom <= 0 or not np.isfinite(denom):
        beta = pd.Series(1.0, index=common)
        mret = 0.0
    else:
        var = denom / max(len(Rd) - 1, 1)
        cov = Rd.mul(md, axis=0).sum() / max(len(Rd) - 1, 1)
        beta = cov / var
        vals = m.dropna().values
        mret = float(np.prod(1.0 + vals) - 1.0) if len(vals) else 0.0
    if not np.isfinite(mret):
        mret = 0.0
    resid_ret = ret120 - beta * mret
    risk_adj = resid_ret / (vol60 * np.sqrt(mom_window))
    mask = (eligible & np.isfinite(last_px) & (last_px > 0) & np.isfinite(vol60) & (vol60 > 0) & np.isfinite(ret120) & np.isfinite(beta) & np.isfinite(resid_ret) & np.isfinite(risk_adj) & (cnt >= 90))
    valid = pd.DataFrame({'vol': vol60, 'ra': risk_adj}, index=common)
    valid = valid[mask.reindex(valid.index).fillna(False)]
    if len(valid) < 10:
        return out
    vol_rank = valid['vol'].rank(method='average', pct=True)
    ra_rank = valid['ra'].rank(method='average', pct=True)
    score = 0.7 * (1.0 - vol_rank) + 0.3 * ra_rank
    score = score.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()
    if len(score) < 10:
        return out
    n_side = min(20, len(score) // 2)
    if n_side < 5:
        return out
    ordered = score.sort_values(ascending=False)
    longs = ordered.iloc[:n_side].index
    shorts = ordered.iloc[-n_side:].index
    w = min(0.02, 0.4 / float(n_side))
    out.loc[longs] = w
    out.loc[shorts] = -w
    out = out.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0).clip(-0.02, 0.02)
    gross = out.abs().sum()
    if gross > 1.0:
        out = out * (1.0 / gross)
    if abs(out.sum()) > 0.01:
        return _zeros(universe)
    return out

import math
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def _zeros(universe):
    return pd.Series(0.0, index=pd.Index(universe), dtype=float)


def _price_frame(history, universe):
    for name in ('adjusted_close', 'close'):
        df = history.get(name)
        if isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame) and df.shape[0] > 0 and df.shape[1] > 0:
            return df.reindex(columns=universe).astype(float)
    return None


def _eligible(history, universe, base_pos):
    elig_df = history.get('eligible')
    if isinstance(elig_df, pd.DataFrame) and elig_df.shape[0] > 0:
        try:
            e = elig_df.reindex(columns=universe).ffill()
            if base_pos >= e.shape[0]:
                row = e.iloc[-1]
            else:
                row = e.iloc[base_pos]
            return row.fillna(False).astype(bool)
        except Exception:
            pass
    return pd.Series(True, index=universe, dtype=bool)


def _soft_neutral_weights(signal, valid, universe):
    weights = _zeros(universe)
    if signal is None:
        return weights
    s = signal.reindex(universe).astype(float)
    v = valid.reindex(universe).fillna(False).astype(bool)
    s = s.where(v)
    s = s.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    s = s.dropna()
    if len(s) < 4:
        return weights
    s = s.clip(-4.0, 4.0)
    s = s - s.mean()
    sd = s.std(ddof=0)
    if not np.isfinite(sd) or sd <= 1e-12:
        return weights
    s = s / sd
    s = np.tanh(s / 1.5)
    s = s.where(s.abs() >= 0.10, 0.0)
    pos = s.clip(lower=0.0)
    neg = (-s).clip(lower=0.0)
    if pos.sum() <= 0.0 or neg.sum() <= 0.0:
        return weights
    long_w = pos / pos.sum() * 0.5
    short_w = -neg / neg.sum() * 0.5
    weights.loc[long_w.index] = long_w.values
    weights.loc[short_w.index] = short_w.values
    weights = weights.clip(-0.02, 0.02)
    lg = float(weights[weights > 0.0].sum())
    sg = float(-weights[weights < 0.0].sum())
    target = min(lg, sg, 0.5)
    if target <= 0.0:
        return _zeros(universe)
    if lg > 0.0:
        pos_mask = weights > 0.0
        weights.loc[pos_mask] = weights.loc[pos_mask] * (target / lg)
    if sg > 0.0:
        neg_mask = weights < 0.0
        weights.loc[neg_mask] = weights.loc[neg_mask] * (target / sg)
    weights = weights.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0)
    gross = float(weights.abs().sum())
    if gross > 1.0 + 1e-12:
        weights = weights / gross
    return weights.astype(float)


def generate_weights(history, universe):
    universe = pd.Index(list(universe))
    weights = _zeros(universe)
    if len(universe) == 0:
        return weights

    raw = _price_frame(history, universe)
    if raw is None:
        return weights
    raw = raw.ffill()
    if raw.shape[0] < 3:
        return weights

    last_pos = raw.shape[0] - 1
    base_pos = last_pos - (last_pos % 5)
    if base_pos < 2:
        base_pos = last_pos

    px_all = raw.iloc[:base_pos + 1]
    if px_all.shape[0] < 64:
        if px_all.shape[0] < 25:
            return weights
        L = min(20, px_all.shape[0] - 1)
        sig = px_all.iloc[-1] / px_all.iloc[-1 - L] - 1.0
        sig = sig.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        elig = _eligible(history, universe, base_pos)
        valid = elig & sig.notna() & np.isfinite(sig) & (px_all.iloc[-1] > 0.0)
        return _soft_neutral_weights(sig, valid, universe)

    px = px_all.tail(320)
    last = px.iloc[-1]
    elig = _eligible(history, universe, base_pos)
    base_valid = last.notna() & np.isfinite(last) & (last > 0.0) & elig
    if not base_valid.any():
        return weights

    ret = px.pct_change()
    ret = ret.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    vol = ret.rolling(63, min_periods=20).std(ddof=0)
    vol = vol.where(vol > 1e-8)

    lookbacks = [63, 126, 252]
    lb_weights = [0.35, 0.35, 0.30]
    comps = []
    for L, wt in zip(lookbacks, lb_weights):
        if px.shape[0] <= L + 1:
            continue
        mom = px / px.shift(L) - 1.0
        mom = mom.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        comp = mom / (vol * math.sqrt(float(L)))
        comp = comp.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        mu = comp.mean(axis=1, skipna=True)
        sd = comp.std(axis=1, ddof=0, skipna=True)
        sd = sd.where(sd > 1e-12)
        z = comp.sub(mu, axis=0).div(sd, axis=0)
        z = z.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        z_s = z.tail(10).mean(axis=0, skipna=True)
        comps.append(z_s * wt)

    if comps:
        signal = pd.concat(comps, axis=1).sum(axis=1, min_count=1)
    else:
        L = min(20, px.shape[0] - 1)
        signal = px.iloc[-1] / px.iloc[-1 - L] - 1.0
        signal = signal.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

    signal = signal.reindex(universe)

    liquid_ok = pd.Series(True, index=universe)
    vol_df = history.get('volume')
    if isinstance(vol_df, pd.DataFrame) and vol_df.shape[0] > 0:
        try:
            vv = vol_df.reindex(index=raw.index, columns=universe).astype(float).ffill()
            start = max(0, base_pos - 19)
            dollar = raw.iloc[start:base_pos + 1] * vv.iloc[start:base_pos + 1]
            liq = dollar.median(axis=0, skipna=True)
            liq_ok = liq.notna() & np.isfinite(liq) & (liq > 0.0)
            if int(liq_ok.sum()) >= max(10, len(universe) // 2):
                q20 = liq[liq_ok].quantile(0.2)
                liquid_ok = liq_ok & (liq >= q20)
        except Exception:
            liquid_ok = pd.Series(True, index=universe)

    valid = (
        base_valid &
        signal.notna() &
        np.isfinite(signal) &
        liquid_ok.reindex(universe).fillna(False)
    )
    return _soft_neutral_weights(signal, valid, universe)

import pandas as pd


def _get_field(history, names, universe):
    for name in names:
        df = history.get(name)
        if isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame):
            return df.reindex(columns=universe).astype(float)
    return None


def generate_weights(history, universe):
    universe = pd.Index(list(universe))
    zero = pd.Series(0.0, index=universe, dtype=float)
    if len(universe) == 0:
        return zero

    close = _get_field(history, ['adjusted_close', 'close'], universe)
    openp = _get_field(history, ['adjusted_open', 'open'], universe)
    volume = _get_field(history, ['volume'], universe)
    if close is None or openp is None or volume is None:
        return zero

    idx = close.index
    if len(idx) < 30:
        return zero

    openp = openp.reindex(index=idx)
    volume = volume.reindex(index=idx)

    elig_df = history.get('eligible')
    if isinstance(elig_df, pd.DataFrame):
        elig = elig_df.reindex(index=idx, columns=universe)
    else:
        elig = None

    n = len(idx)
    last_pos = n - 1
    base_pos = last_pos - (last_pos % 5)

    max_rows = 180
    start = max(0, n - max_rows)
    if base_pos < start + 25:
        base_pos = last_pos
    if base_pos < 25:
        return zero

    sl = slice(start, base_pos + 1)
    c = close.iloc[sl]
    o = openp.iloc[sl]
    v = volume.iloc[sl]
    if len(c) < 25:
        return zero

    if elig is not None:
        e = elig.iloc[sl].fillna(False).astype(bool)
    else:
        e = pd.DataFrame(True, index=c.index, columns=universe)

    prev_close = c.shift(1)
    overnight = o / prev_close - 1.0
    intraday = c / o - 1.0
    overnight = overnight.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    intraday = intraday.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

    log_o = np.log1p(overnight)
    log_i = np.log1p(intraday)

    valid_px = (c > 0.0) & (o > 0.0) & (prev_close > 0.0)
    base_valid = e & valid_px
    log_o = log_o.where(base_valid)
    log_i = log_i.where(base_valid)

    v_ma = v.rolling(20, min_periods=10).mean()
    v_base = v.rolling(60, min_periods=20).median()
    ratio = v_ma / v_base
    ratio = ratio.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).clip(lower=0.2, upper=5.0)
    log_shock = np.log(ratio)
    rs = log_shock.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
    factor = 1.0 + 0.5 * rs.fillna(0.0)

    components = []
    for lookback in (10, 20):
        cum_o = np.expm1(log_o.rolling(lookback, min_periods=lookback).sum())
        cum_i = np.expm1(log_i.rolling(lookback, min_periods=lookback).sum())
        cum_o = cum_o.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).clip(lower=-0.9, upper=5.0)
        cum_i = cum_i.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).clip(lower=-0.9, upper=5.0)
        rank_o = cum_o.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        rank_i = cum_i.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        components.append(rank_o - rank_i * factor)

    score_daily = (components[0] + components[1]) / 2.0
    recent = score_daily.tail(5)
    score = recent.mean(axis=0, skipna=True)
    score_count = recent.count(axis=0)
    score = score.where(score_count >= 3)

    last_elig = e.iloc[-1]
    last_close = c.iloc[-1]
    last_open = o.iloc[-1]
    last_volume = v.iloc[-1]
    dollar_vol = (c * v).tail(20).median(axis=0)

    valid = (
        last_elig &
        last_close.notna() & last_open.notna() & last_volume.notna() &
        (last_close > 0.0) & (last_open > 0.0) & (last_volume > 0.0) &
        dollar_vol.notna() & (dollar_vol > 0.0) &
        score.notna() & np.isfinite(score)
    )

    if int(valid.sum()) < 4:
        return zero

    candidates = score[valid].sort_values(ascending=False, kind='mergesort')
    m = len(candidates)
    n_side = min(30, m // 2)
    if n_side < 1:
        return zero

    longs = candidates.index[:n_side]
    shorts = candidates.index[-n_side:]
    per_name = min(0.02, 0.45 / float(n_side))

    weights = zero.copy()
    weights.loc[longs] = per_name
    weights.loc[shorts] = -per_name
    weights = weights.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0)
    weights = weights.clip(lower=-0.02, upper=0.02)

    gross = float(weights.abs().sum())
    if gross > 1.0:
        weights = weights / gross

    return weights.astype(float)

import math
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def _zeros(universe):
    return pd.Series(0.0, index=pd.Index(universe), dtype=float)


def _price_frame(history, universe):
    for name in ('adjusted_close', 'close'):
        df = history.get(name)
        if isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame) and df.shape[0] > 0 and df.shape[1] > 0:
            return df.reindex(columns=universe).astype(float)
    return None


def _eligible(history, universe, base_pos):
    elig_df = history.get('eligible')
    if isinstance(elig_df, pd.DataFrame) and elig_df.shape[0] > 0:
        try:
            e = elig_df.reindex(columns=universe).ffill()
            if base_pos >= e.shape[0]:
                row = e.iloc[-1]
            else:
                row = e.iloc[base_pos]
            return row.fillna(False).astype(bool)
        except Exception:
            pass
    return pd.Series(True, index=universe, dtype=bool)


def _soft_neutral_weights(signal, valid, universe):
    weights = _zeros(universe)
    if signal is None:
        return weights
    s = signal.reindex(universe).astype(float)
    v = valid.reindex(universe).fillna(False).astype(bool)
    s = s.where(v)
    s = s.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    s = s.dropna()
    if len(s) < 4:
        return weights
    s = s.clip(-4.0, 4.0)
    s = s - s.mean()
    sd = s.std(ddof=0)
    if not np.isfinite(sd) or sd <= 1e-12:
        return weights
    s = s / sd
    s = np.tanh(s / 1.5)
    s = s.where(s.abs() >= 0.10, 0.0)
    pos = s.clip(lower=0.0)
    neg = (-s).clip(lower=0.0)
    if pos.sum() <= 0.0 or neg.sum() <= 0.0:
        return weights
    long_w = pos / pos.sum() * 0.5
    short_w = -neg / neg.sum() * 0.5
    weights.loc[long_w.index] = long_w.values
    weights.loc[short_w.index] = short_w.values
    weights = weights.clip(-0.02, 0.02)
    lg = float(weights[weights > 0.0].sum())
    sg = float(-weights[weights < 0.0].sum())
    target = min(lg, sg, 0.5)
    if target <= 0.0:
        return _zeros(universe)
    if lg > 0.0:
        pos_mask = weights > 0.0
        weights.loc[pos_mask] = weights.loc[pos_mask] * (target / lg)
    if sg > 0.0:
        neg_mask = weights < 0.0
        weights.loc[neg_mask] = weights.loc[neg_mask] * (target / sg)
    weights = weights.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0)
    gross = float(weights.abs().sum())
    if gross > 1.0 + 1e-12:
        weights = weights / gross
    return weights.astype(float)


def generate_weights(history, universe):
    universe = pd.Index(list(universe))
    weights = _zeros(universe)
    if len(universe) == 0:
        return weights

    raw = _price_frame(history, universe)
    if raw is None:
        return weights
    raw = raw.ffill()
    if raw.shape[0] < 3:
        return weights

    last_pos = raw.shape[0] - 1
    base_pos = last_pos - (last_pos % 5)
    if base_pos < 2:
        base_pos = last_pos

    px_all = raw.iloc[:base_pos + 1]
    if px_all.shape[0] < 64:
        if px_all.shape[0] < 25:
            return weights
        L = min(20, px_all.shape[0] - 1)
        sig = px_all.iloc[-1] / px_all.iloc[-1 - L] - 1.0
        sig = sig.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        elig = _eligible(history, universe, base_pos)
        valid = elig & sig.notna() & np.isfinite(sig) & (px_all.iloc[-1] > 0.0)
        return _soft_neutral_weights(sig, valid, universe)

    px = px_all.tail(320)
    last = px.iloc[-1]
    elig = _eligible(history, universe, base_pos)
    base_valid = last.notna() & np.isfinite(last) & (last > 0.0) & elig
    if not base_valid.any():
        return weights

    ret = px.pct_change()
    ret = ret.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    vol = ret.rolling(63, min_periods=20).std(ddof=0)
    vol = vol.where(vol > 1e-8)

    lookbacks = [63, 126, 252]
    lb_weights = [0.35, 0.35, 0.30]
    comps = []
    for L, wt in zip(lookbacks, lb_weights):
        if px.shape[0] <= L + 1:
            continue
        mom = px / px.shift(L) - 1.0
        mom = mom.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        comp = mom / (vol * math.sqrt(float(L)))
        comp = comp.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        mu = comp.mean(axis=1, skipna=True)
        sd = comp.std(axis=1, ddof=0, skipna=True)
        sd = sd.where(sd > 1e-12)
        z = comp.sub(mu, axis=0).div(sd, axis=0)
        z = z.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        z_s = z.tail(10).mean(axis=0, skipna=True)
        comps.append(z_s * wt)

    if comps:
        signal = pd.concat(comps, axis=1).sum(axis=1, min_count=1)
    else:
        L = min(20, px.shape[0] - 1)
        signal = px.iloc[-1] / px.iloc[-1 - L] - 1.0
        signal = signal.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

    signal = signal.reindex(universe)

    liquid_ok = pd.Series(True, index=universe)
    vol_df = history.get('volume')
    if isinstance(vol_df, pd.DataFrame) and vol_df.shape[0] > 0:
        try:
            vv = vol_df.reindex(index=raw.index, columns=universe).astype(float).ffill()
            start = max(0, base_pos - 19)
            dollar = raw.iloc[start:base_pos + 1] * vv.iloc[start:base_pos + 1]
            liq = dollar.median(axis=0, skipna=True)
            liq_ok = liq.notna() & np.isfinite(liq) & (liq > 0.0)
            if int(liq_ok.sum()) >= max(10, len(universe) // 2):
                q20 = liq[liq_ok].quantile(0.2)
                liquid_ok = liq_ok & (liq >= q20)
        except Exception:
            liquid_ok = pd.Series(True, index=universe)

    valid = (
        base_valid &
        signal.notna() &
        np.isfinite(signal) &
        liquid_ok.reindex(universe).fillna(False)
    )
    return _soft_neutral_weights(signal, valid, universe)

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def _get_field(history, names, universe):
    for name in names:
        df = history.get(name)
        if isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame):
            return df.reindex(columns=universe).astype(float)
    return None


def generate_weights(history, universe):
    universe = pd.Index(list(universe))
    zero = pd.Series(0.0, index=universe, dtype=float)
    if len(universe) == 0:
        return zero

    close = _get_field(history, ['adjusted_close', 'close'], universe)
    openp = _get_field(history, ['adjusted_open', 'open'], universe)
    volume = _get_field(history, ['volume'], universe)
    if close is None or openp is None or volume is None:
        return zero

    idx = close.index
    if len(idx) < 30:
        return zero

    openp = openp.reindex(index=idx)
    volume = volume.reindex(index=idx)

    elig_df = history.get('eligible')
    if isinstance(elig_df, pd.DataFrame):
        elig = elig_df.reindex(index=idx, columns=universe)
    else:
        elig = None

    n = len(idx)
    last_pos = n - 1
    base_pos = last_pos - (last_pos % 5)

    max_rows = 180
    start = max(0, n - max_rows)
    if base_pos < start + 25:
        base_pos = last_pos
    if base_pos < 25:
        return zero

    sl = slice(start, base_pos + 1)
    c = close.iloc[sl]
    o = openp.iloc[sl]
    v = volume.iloc[sl]
    if len(c) < 25:
        return zero

    if elig is not None:
        e = elig.iloc[sl].fillna(False).astype(bool)
    else:
        e = pd.DataFrame(True, index=c.index, columns=universe)

    prev_close = c.shift(1)
    overnight = o / prev_close - 1.0
    intraday = c / o - 1.0
    overnight = overnight.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    intraday = intraday.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

    log_o = np.log1p(overnight)
    log_i = np.log1p(intraday)

    valid_px = (c > 0.0) & (o > 0.0) & (prev_close > 0.0)
    base_valid = e & valid_px
    log_o = log_o.where(base_valid)
    log_i = log_i.where(base_valid)

    v_ma = v.rolling(20, min_periods=10).mean()
    v_base = v.rolling(60, min_periods=20).median()
    ratio = v_ma / v_base
    ratio = ratio.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).clip(lower=0.2, upper=5.0)
    log_shock = np.log(ratio)
    rs = log_shock.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
    factor = 1.0 + 0.5 * rs.fillna(0.0)

    components = []
    for lookback in (10, 20):
        cum_o = np.expm1(log_o.rolling(lookback, min_periods=lookback).sum())
        cum_i = np.expm1(log_i.rolling(lookback, min_periods=lookback).sum())
        cum_o = cum_o.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).clip(lower=-0.9, upper=5.0)
        cum_i = cum_i.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).clip(lower=-0.9, upper=5.0)
        rank_o = cum_o.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        rank_i = cum_i.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        components.append(rank_o - rank_i * factor)

    score_daily = (components[0] + components[1]) / 2.0
    recent = score_daily.tail(5)
    score = recent.mean(axis=0, skipna=True)
    score_count = recent.count(axis=0)
    score = score.where(score_count >= 3)

    last_elig = e.iloc[-1]
    last_close = c.iloc[-1]
    last_open = o.iloc[-1]
    last_volume = v.iloc[-1]
    dollar_vol = (c * v).tail(20).median(axis=0)

    valid = (
        last_elig &
        last_close.notna() & last_open.notna() & last_volume.notna() &
        (last_close > 0.0) & (last_open > 0.0) & (last_volume > 0.0) &
        dollar_vol.notna() & (dollar_vol > 0.0) &
        score.notna() & np.isfinite(score)
    )

    if int(valid.sum()) < 4:
        return zero

    candidates = score[valid].sort_values(ascending=False, kind='mergesort')
    m = len(candidates)
    n_side = min(30, m // 2)
    if n_side < 1:
        return zero

    longs = candidates.index[:n_side]
    shorts = candidates.index[-n_side:]
    per_name = min(0.02, 0.45 / float(n_side))

    weights = zero.copy()
    weights.loc[longs] = per_name
    weights.loc[shorts] = -per_name
    weights = weights.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0)
    weights = weights.clip(lower=-0.02, upper=0.02)

    gross = float(weights.abs().sum())
    if gross > 1.0:
        weights = weights / gross

    return weights.astype(float)
